verdict.what_happens: The initially tilted first domino falls under gravity and triggers sequential impacts through all ten dominoes. The cascade reaches domino10 at 0.72 s, and all ten settle by about 1 s. At 6 s, every domino is at rest and tilted approximately 73–90 degrees from upright.

usage.text:
The first domino starts leaning 20° forward and falls under gravity, hitting domino2 at 0.07 s. The impacts propagate down the row, reaching domino10 at 0.72 s. All ten settle by about 1 s and remain at rest through 6 s.

At the end, domino1 is approximately 76° from upright, domino2–domino9 are approximately 73°, and domino10 is approximately 90°. Every domino exceeds the required 15° tilt, so the scene satisfies the brief.
